bare-wire.fix: Make the crema actually close the scar instead of drawing a second ripple. Delete the growing .heal disc. Let the dark .scar disc open fast (scale .05 to .55 over the first 0.25s, ease-out), then shrink it back to 0 over the remaining 2.25s with a slow ease-in-out, so the crema visibly flows in from the edge and the hole closes at its centre. Slow the beat from 1s to 2.5s (two drops per 5s loop, landing in different off-centre spots, e.g. translate(5 4) then translate(-6 -3)) so at 120px it reads as liquid settling, not a 1Hz sonar ping. Keep the 5s field breathe under it.
bare-wire.keep: The restraint: six filled shapes, transform and opacity only, one markup at every size, and the slow 5s crema breathe that makes the surface feel alive.

warm-hands.fix: Stop spinning the finished latte art as a rigid decal. Replace the 360-degree .sweep with a pour that moves while the art stays put: a sienna pour point (the .tip) travels the spiral path once per 5s via offset-path/offset-distance, a thin cream stream drops onto it from above the rim, and the already-poured spiral only drifts about 15 degrees and swells a few percent (scale 1 to 1.04) as if the surface is settling under the new milk. Keep it all on the shared 5s clock so the loop still has no seam.
warm-hands.keep: The hand-made world: wobbled rim, thumb smudge, coffee-ring stain and the sienna pour tip. It is the only entry that looks like a specific cafe and not a generic coffee app.

the-glitch.fix: Take out everything that is UI and not coffee: delete the five orange pips and the striped band on the outside of the cup. Put the crema where it lives, on the coffee surface ellipse inside the rim, and let each landing drop lighten and widen it a step (opacity and scaleX on the surface ellipse, five steps that reset when the cup is swapped at 5.0s). If you want to keep a 'hiccup', make it a real espresso event: once per loop the drip thickens into a short continuous stream for 0.5s (a scaleY-stretched drop), the way a shot gushes before it settles, instead of a misregistered stripe that reads as a render bug.
the-glitch.keep: The falling drop: swell at the spout, gravity ease-in fall, and a flat ring on impact. It is the one honestly observed coffee gesture in the piece.
